chunks: Say to those who do not believe, 'Act according to your capacity; indeed, we are acting.'

key_terms.لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ: to those who do not believe

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'act according to your capacity' in Surah Hud?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Hud, this verse (11:6) serves as a divine reassurance to the Prophet Muhammad, instructing him to allow the disbelievers to persist in their current state of denial while the believers continue their steadfast worship. Shia exegetes often highlight this as a demonstration of divine patience and the inevitability of justice, where each group's actions naturally lead to their predetermined fate without immediate divine intervention.
